purpose: Actual native imagegen requests for current Pixel Explainer Notes subjects; canonical preparation hashes remain in illustration-prompts.json

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent standalone subject for a Chinese explanatory video, Pixel Explainer Notes. Create one refined 16-bit pixel art illustration of an expressive young adult with tousled dark hair, pale blue casual shirt, charcoal trousers, seated cross-legged, holding an open blue book and resting their cheek thoughtfully on one hand; a small stack of 3 books immediately beside them. Front three-quarter view, full body, centered compact silhouette, ample transparent margins. Everyday reading scene, like a polished editorial pixel illustration. Crisp visible square pixel clusters of consistent size, stepped silhouette, limited palette, rich carefully placed pixel highlights and shadows, dark navy outlines, expressive face, blue and warm skin colors. Render at an apparent 160–200 pixel subject height enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor edges. Genuine transparent background. NO text, labels, letters, watermark, full slide, card, paper texture, tape, scenery, castle, game map, quest, adventure, HUD, continuous smooth shading, blur or antialiased vector contours.
assets.review: Codex inspected the actual PNG for pixel medium, complete subject, legible facial/object details, no in-image text, and genuine transparency; registration verifies alpha and file bytes.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: an independent transparent subject for a narrated explainer video.
Subject: Three overlapping loose document sheets in a disorganized pile, simple abstract bars on pages, one small blue sticky note. Isolated coherent everyday object. Crisp navy outlines, ivory pages, blue and coral highlights.
Style: Refined editorial 16-bit pixel illustration of expressive everyday people, objects or a compact local situation. Crisp square pixel clusters on a consistent grid, stepped silhouettes, carefully placed limited-palette highlights and shadows, dark navy pixel outlines, readable expressive faces and interesting small details. Blue, coral and warm natural skin colors. Apparent subject resolution about 160–200 pixels high enlarged with nearest-neighbor crisp edges. The subject itself must be pixel art, not a smooth cartoon inside a pixel frame. NO blur, smooth vector curves, paper fibers, tape, card, castle, game level, map, adventure, quest, HUD or in-image text. Isolated complete subject on genuine transparency.
Palette: #172033, #1688f8, #de3e49, #a7c9ed, #edbc96.
Keep the entire subject intact with generous clear margin. Use a genuinely transparent background.
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, captions, arrows, labels or surrounding slide. Text and relationships will be rendered separately.
